title: Following the ? operator
subtitle: Choose which call fails, then step through the function

captions.start: The caller invokes load_config. Press Step to follow the value through each ?.
captions.call: {fn} runs and returns a Result. The ? inspects it before anything else happens.
captions.ok: {fn} returned Ok: ? unwraps the value, binds it, and execution continues on the next line.
captions.err: {fn} returned Err(e): ? converts the error with From::from(e) into an AppError…
captions.returnErr: …and returns it immediately. The remaining lines never run, and the caller receives Err. No stack unwinding, no exception: just an early return.
captions.returnOk: All three calls succeeded, so the function reaches its last expression and returns Ok(cfg) to the caller.
